after.zh: 被擦的那块和远处的孪生块最像，于是一步就从对角取回了缺的格子。这就是自注意力：每个图块（token）用 q·k/√d 和所有图块打分，softmax 把分数变成和为 1 的权重，再对 v 加权平均。3×3 卷积叠 L 层也只看到 (2L+1)×(2L+1)。
after.en: The erased patch looks most like its far-off twin, so in one step it fetched the missing pixels from the opposite corner. That is self-attention: each patch (token) scores every patch with q·k/√d, softmax turns the scores into weights that sum to 1, and the v are averaged with those weights. Stack L layers of 3×3 convolution and you still only see (2L+1)×(2L+1).

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="attention"></part-ref>把 16×16 的图切成 16 个 4×4 的图块，每块都向所有图块提问。参数「q 放大」把分数一起放大：放得越大，越只看最像的几块。
t.en: The <part-ref to="attention"></part-ref> in the tray cuts the 16×16 image into 16 patches of 4×4, and every patch asks every patch. The "q scale" parameter scales up all the scores: the larger it is, the more each patch looks only at the few most alike.

t.zh: 测试图的一对对角上本是同一个小图案，其中一个被擦掉几格；也有一组什么都没擦。这一关最多 3 个节点。要想的是：被擦掉的格子，图里哪里还留着它的样子？
t.en: In each test image, two opposite corners hold the same small pattern, but one has had a few pixels erased; one set has nothing erased. This level allows at most 3 nodes. The question is: where else in the image does an erased pixel still show what it looked like?

caption.zh: 第一组：左上角的图案缺了几格
caption.en: Set 1: the top-left pattern is missing a few pixels

brief.zh: 一对对角上本是同一个图案，其中一个被擦掉了几格。把它补回来，其余不变；最多 3 个节点。
brief.en: Two opposite corners hold the same pattern, but a few pixels of one copy have been erased. Restore them and leave everything else unchanged; at most 3 nodes.

hint.zh: 3×3 的元件一次只看一格远。注意力让每个图块和所有图块比；q 放大越大，越只看最像的几块。
hint.en: A 3×3 part only sees one pixel away at a time. Attention lets each patch compare itself with every patch; the larger the q scale, the more it looks only at the few most similar ones.
